name: mother-now
description: The Now panel for MOTHER: what's on you and what the team is neglecting, beside the chat. Also shows the hub: its health, the sessions it routes into, cards waiting to be started and hub updates. Reads the tick's now.json and the hub's files; makes no network or MCP calls.

mother_bin.title: MOTHER command
mother_bin.description: Path to the mother script, used to find the workspace (`mother path`). A leading ~ is the home folder.
